BTCUSDT.notes: Anchor asset. Highly respected HTF liquidity pools. Major liquidity grabs occur during NY Open (13:30-15:00 UTC).

ETHUSDT.notes: Correlated with BTC with beta 1.15x. Gas and funding surges often precede local trend exhaustion.

SOLUSDT.notes: High retail momentum. Requires wider invalidation stops due to frequent secondary liquidity sweeps.

BNBUSDT.notes: Exchange native anchor. High institutional bid support; low false breakout rate on HTF.

XRPUSDT.notes: Heavy retail speculation and sharp wick expansions. Strict trailing stops required.

optimal_setups: Volume Surge Breakout with Tight Trailing
DOGEUSDT.notes: Meme momentum driver. Strict fractional Kelly sizing required (max 1.5% risk).

ADAUSDT.notes: Tends to form extended consolidation ranges before directional expansion.

AVAXUSDT.notes: High beta to SOL and layer-1 rotations. Strong trend continuation when 1H EMA 50 aligns.

SUIUSDT.notes: High momentum layer-1 leader. High R:R potential on trending days; avoid counter-trend shorts.

NEARUSDT.notes: AI and Web3 infrastructure bellwether. Clean price action on 1H timeframes.

LINKUSDT.notes: Oracle leader with strong fundamental holding. Highly respects horizontal support and resistance.

UNIUSDT.notes: DeFi sector leader. High sensitivity to Ethereum gas and regulatory news.

THEUSDT.notes: Low cap dex token. Extreme wick volatility; cap maximum exposure to 1% risk.

ZECUSDT.notes: Privacy coin idiosyncratic movement. Prone to sharp mean reversions.

WLDUSDT.notes: High float unlock volatility and strong short squeezes.

SOPHUSDT.notes: Micro-cap altcoin. Strict stop loss required immediately upon entry.

TRXUSDT.notes: High stability and low beta to broader market; stable trend continuation.

ENAUSDT.notes: Synthetic dollar yield token; strongly skewed by funding rates.

PEPEUSDT.notes: Top tier meme coin. Rapid volume explosions; requires tight trailing stop at +1.5R.

WIFUSDT.notes: High beta meme correlated with SOL. Fast reversals upon hitting daily pivots.

APTUSDT.notes: Layer-1 altcoin with aggressive market maker manipulation near unlocks.

ARBUSDT.notes: Arbitrum governance token. High liquidity depth on futures.

OPUSDT.notes: Optimism ecosystem driver. Clean trends when ETH leads the market.

TIAUSDT.notes: Modular blockchain leader. Highly reactive to staking and unlock news.

INJUSDT.notes: Cosmos DeFi hub. Strong institutional market-maker presence.

RENDERUSDT.notes: Decentralized GPU compute bellwether. High correlation with Nvidia earnings & tech sentiment.

FETUSDT.notes: AI narrative leader. Sharp momentum bursts during Asian & London sessions.

SEIUSDT.notes: High-throughput trading chain. Clean lower timeframe trends.

FTMUSDT.notes: High retail interest. Wide stop loss required during volatility spikes.

tactical_rules.rule_text: Do not execute new breakout entries within 45 minutes of High-Impact FOMC / CPI releases.
Always wait for Lower Timeframe (1m-5m) MSS (Market Structure Shift) confirmation after 15m/1H Liquidity Sweep.
Avoid aggressive Long entries when 8h Funding Rate exceeds +0.06% (Long Crowding Danger).
Only execute Scalp/Swing positions aligned with the 4H & Daily EMA 50/200 directional bias.
Only add pyramiding size (+30%) when original Stop Loss is locked beyond Breakeven (+0.5R).

episodic_memories.root_cause: Clean HTF liquidity raid below previous week low followed by rapid volume absorption.
episodic_memories.lesson_learned: Wyckoff Springs below Monday lows have >75% win rate when open interest declines during the sweep.

episodic_memories.root_cause: Chased 15m green candle into 4H bearish breaker with funding rate at +0.075%. Trapped by smart money distribution.
episodic_memories.lesson_learned: Never buy breakout into HTF breaker when funding is crowded long. Wait for pullback into discount FVG.

episodic_memories.root_cause: Rejection from premium 1H FVG after sweep of Asian Session High during London open.
episodic_memories.lesson_learned: London open sweep of Asian High provides high R:R short setups targeting Asian Lows.
